## Why visit

The natural companion to Wigan Central and a good destination in its own right. The tiled drinking corridor, mosaic entrance and stained glass reward a slow look, while the beer offer gives the visit more substance than architecture alone. Its careful restoration is part of the story: not every fitting is original, and CAMRA explains the repairs following a serious fire. For this trip the combination of local mild, classic bitter, pies and a railway-hotel atmosphere is particularly appealing. It is also convenient enough to make a short Wigan visit practical.

## Beer

CAMRA records seven handpumps with Draught Bass and Bank Top Dark Mild among the regulars, plus guests; check availability.

## Food

Official site advertises Pieminister pies, other hot dishes, pork pies and Scotch eggs, including a vegan option.

## Plan the visit

Historic interiors include restored/replacement elements after the 1985 fire. Check food hours and match-day atmosphere.

**Getting there:** Directly opposite Wigan North Western; Wallgate station is also nearby.
